## Research status

**Technical owners.** 6 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Readiness Gates, Residual Escrow, and Quarantine](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/readiness-gates-residual-escrow-and-quarantine.html), [Benchmark Ratchets and Anti-Goodhart Evidence](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/benchmark-ratchets-and-anti-goodhart-evidence.html), [Capability Thresholds and Deployment Commitments](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/capability-thresholds-and-deployment-commitments.html), [Adversarial Evaluation, Sandbagging, and Training-Time Deception](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-evaluation-sandbagging-and-training-time-deception.html), [Safety Cases and Structured Assurance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/safety-cases-and-structured-assurance.html), [Content Authenticity, Watermarking, and Synthetic Media Integrity](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/content-authenticity-watermarking-and-synthetic-media-integrity.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 31.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Leaner readiness methods that detect deception, staleness, provenance failure, and deployment risk equally well under adaptive pressure would justify consolidation.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
